gate: exact same-route I32 greedy-token identity and zero maximum absolute NLL delta for selected-route ordinary graph/eager execution at 8K and 32K; MTP3/ordinary and MTP3/MTP4 are optional non-ranking diagnostics and are not admission prerequisites
bf16_contract: candidate-to-BF16 argmax mismatches remain diagnostic; the selected quality tier still gates NLL/severe positions. Preparation binds the validated 18-shard source receipt and repeats target-owned checkpoint preflight before GPU work.
binding: one schema-v7 winner, exact evaluation artifact/scorer bytes, selected G16/G32 cache and dense/tau0.9 profile, selected chunk, candidate-local quality authority, deterministic BF16 scorer/source/corpus, and hybrid receipt/planner when selected
publication: Preparation rejects occupied output names under lexical lstat semantics, including dangling symlinks, and atomically publishes the complete staged command directory with renameat2(RENAME_NOREPLACE). Generated commands reject symlinked/occupied campaign and admission names, and the shared PPL runner refuses to write through a real or dangling output-directory symlink. The raw campaign directory is fresh evidence and never overwritten. The validator reconstructs every one of the six canonical weights/corpus/decode/spec-none/chunk/graph-or-eager commands and requires matching raw semantic fields before recomputing sidecar parity. Only the independently recomputed admission JSON is authoritative; it is fsynced to an exclusive pending inode, create-only hard-linked, read back, fully revalidated, directory-fsynced, and cleaned up or rolled back only when the path still names the owned inode.
scope: C1 only; no separate BF16-greedy identity threshold, generation suite, or candidate matrix
